ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0007 requires epigraph verification and CTD-0082 covers the same ground for this volume. The Rumi attribution carries a pending verification marker in the shipped text, and that marker is kept.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. The shipped section is a rewritten definition plus a second paragraph that has no counterpart in the baseline. The damage report shows this tenet at minus one hundred percent because the pass demoted it to a fourth level heading, so its words fold into the tier above. The content was renamed, not deleted, but almost none of the baseline wording survives inside it.

findings.summary: The tenet lost its derivation from the tenet before it.

evidence.baseline: Once an erotic, turned-on relationship with life is established, Loving Presence is simply that turned-on awareness made constant.

findings.diagnosis: This is the second of the two joints in the relating tier, and it is the sentence that makes Loving Presence a development of Wholesome Eroticism rather than a separate virtue. Simply that made constant is also the whole definition: nothing new is added, only duration.

findings.summary: The two failure modes the tenet guards against were cut.

evidence.baseline: It is the warmth that keeps presence from going cold and clinical, and the steadiness that keeps love from going sentimental.
evidence.shipped: It asks for warmth without sentimentality and steadiness without clinical distance.

findings.diagnosis: The baseline crosses the terms: warmth guards presence, steadiness guards love. The shipped version pairs warmth with sentimentality and steadiness with clinical distance, which reverses both assignments and turns a chiasmus into a contradiction. This is a semantic error introduced by compression, not a loss of ornament.

findings.summary: A claim about authorship of experience was removed rather than bounded.

evidence.baseline: most of all the one with ourselves, who are the author of all our experience
evidence.shipped: A person is not the sole author of everything they experience

findings.diagnosis: The universal is unearned and the correction is right. But the correction was applied by deleting the subject, so the shipped tenet no longer says that the most important relation is the one with oneself, which is the tenet’s first claim. The re-render restores the subject and drops the universal.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Two em dashes. One introduced an enumeration of what may arrive and became a comma pair. One introduced the attribution and is handled by the marker.
Who are the author of all our experience dropped under section 5. Most of all the one with ourselves restored.
The derivation from tenet four, the meeting of whatever arrives, the crossed guard against cold and sentimental, and the most reliable instrument close.
The proportion paragraph about help and rescue, which is substituted prose and one of the best things in the shipped text.

improvements.summary: The proportion paragraph is pass-authored and gives loving presence its failure modes.

evidence.baseline: Held together, presence and love become the single most reliable instrument we have for changing the quality of a moment.
evidence.shipped: Sometimes the practice is active help. Sometimes it is the refusal to explain another person's pain before hearing it. Love becomes credible through proportion, neither abandonment nor rescue staged for the rescuer.

improvements.note: The baseline ends on the instrument's reliability; the kept paragraph names the two ways the instrument is misused. The refusal to explain pain before hearing it is the most practicable sentence in the tenet. Promoted from a quiet kept to a credited finding.

substitutionTest.rule: Standing surviving-sentence count, run for every section before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Baseline sentences of four or more words, counted before any pairing test. Emphasis and typographic quotes normalized and punctuation set aside, so a sentence survives when its exact word sequence appears contiguously in the current section; a punctuation-only repair therefore counts as surviving and any wording change does not. Display lines, tables, epigraphs, liturgy lines, and the interpunct divider excluded. The count is a floor on fidelity, not a judgment of it.
substitutionTest.note: The count is nonzero, so the section is not in substitution mode and the pairing tests apply. Non-survivors attributed: the recorded removal of who are the author of all our experience, answered by the kept counterpoint that a person is not the sole author of everything they experience, and the recorded reduction of single most reliable to most reliable. The Rumi attribution stays visibly unresolved per section 9, CTD-0007, and CTD-0082. No unattributed loss.
